caps.text: The map picture is years old. What's there now?
caps.sub: Find the newest satellite pictures of the place.

caps.text: Every free source at once, newest first
caps.sub: Each one shows its date, its satellite and how cloudy it was.

caps.text: Pick a clear one and it goes on the map
caps.sub: With its date on it, so an old picture is never taken for today's.

caps.text: See the place as it is, before you go or decide
caps.sub: Sentinel-2, Landsat and NASA daily pictures, free for any place on earth.
